## Question

What is needed on the head node to publish this build log, given the box is
arm64 and neither tool was present.

## Setup

- hardware: head node, `6.17.0-1031-nvidia-64k`, 64 KiB pages, arm64
- command: install the arm64 `.deb` releases directly, since neither tool is in
  the distribution repositories at a useful version

```bash
curl -sLO https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v2.100.0/gh_2.100.0_linux_arm64.deb
curl -sLO https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/releases/download/v1.10.18/quarto-1.10.18-linux-arm64.deb
sudo dpkg -i gh_2.100.0_linux_arm64.deb quarto-1.10.18-linux-arm64.deb
```

## Result

`gh` 2.100.0 and `quarto` 1.10.18 installed. `quarto check` reports its bundled
dependencies healthy on arm64: Pandoc 3.10.0, Dart Sass 1.101.0, Deno 2.7.14,
Typst 0.15.1. No architecture-specific failures.

## Verdict

Accepted. Quarto renders locally on the head node, so a broken build can be
caught before it reaches CI rather than after.

## Evidence

`quarto check` output at install time; versions pinned above.
